html:
Thanks.
I’ve used MongoDbEmbeddingStore (from dev.langchain4j.langchain4j-mongodb-atlas) to store and search embeddings. I recommend it. I’ve used a different collection for embeddings (I don’t use transactions collection for storing embeddings). Indeed, I preload only embeddings of suspicious transactions for every user, so every new transaction is checked against this collection
